<analysis>
Let me chronologically analyze the conversation:

1. User asked to open `UnrealEngine_Bridge.uproject` - I read the .uproject file, found it's UE 5.7, located the engine at `C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.7`, and launched it.

2. User asked to enable Remote Control API plugin - I found it was already enabled in .uproject and configured in `Config/DefaultRemoteControl.ini`. The HTTP server wasn't responding yet because editor was still loading.

3. User asked to check if editor was ready - curl to localhost:30010 returned "Not ready yet" multiple times.

4. User asked to check again - still not ready. I checked for the process and found no Unreal process running. Suggested the editor didn't launch or closed.

5. User asked to open from Epic Games Launcher - I explained I can't interact with GUI and gave manual instructions.

6. User said "it wont open" - I tried launching directly with error capture, found no process. Checked logs at `C:\Users\User\UnrealEngine_Bridge\Saved\Logs\UnrealEngine_Bridge.log` and found build errors:
   - `IWYUSupportMode` doesn't exist in UE 5.7
   - Module rules compilation failed

7. Fixed Build.cs files (3 files):
   - `UEBridgeEditor.Build.cs` - removed `IWYUSupport = IWYUSupportMode.Full;`
   - `UEBridgeRuntime.Build.cs` - removed `IWYUSupport = IWYUSupportMode.Full;`
   - `UnrealEngineBridge.Build.cs` - removed `IWYUSupport = IWYUSupport.Full;` block

8. User said "says it couldnt be compiled try from source manually" - Ran Build.bat manually, got UHT error: `UFUNCTION` in USTRUCT at BridgeTypes.h:217.

9. Fixed BridgeTypes.h - removed `UFUNCTION` macro from `IsValid()` in `FUEBridgeProfile` struct.

10. Found and fixed API macro naming issues - old fork names needed updating:
    - `TRANSLATORSBRIDGERUNTIME_API` → `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API` (in BridgeTypes.h, UEBridgeSubsystem.h, UEBridgeStyle.h)
    - `TRANSLATORSCARD_API` → `UNREALENGINEBRIDGE_API` (in 9 Source/ files)
    - `TRANSLATORSBRIDGEEDITOR_API` → `UEBRIDGEEDITOR_API` (in BridgeEditorSubsystem.h)

11. Build attempt 2 - two new errors:
    - `EditorSubsystem.h` not found at `Subsystems/EditorSubsystem.h` - fixed to `EditorSubsystem.h`
    - `LogUEBridge` unresolved external - added `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API` to `DECLARE_LOG_CATEGORY_EXTERN`

12. Build attempt 3 - one error: `IsProcRunning` takes non-const `FProcHandle&` but called from const method. Fixed by moving `const_cast` before the `IsProcRunning` call.

13. Build attempt 4 - SUCCESS! Launched editor.

14. User reported assertion crash: `StyleInstance.IsValid()` in UEBridgeStyle.cpp:37 during CDO construction. Fixed by changing `Get()` from `check(StyleInstance.IsValid())` to lazy initialization.

15. Build attempt 5 - SUCCESS! Launched editor.

16. Editor came up, Remote Control API responding on port 30010 - confirmed working.

17. User reported Vulkan crash (`EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION` in `nvoglv64`). I relaunched with `-dx12` flag.

18. User asked to copy project to `G:\UNREAL_PROJECTS_2025`. Used robocopy excluding Intermediate, Binaries, Saved, .git, DerivedDataCache. Verified copy, launched from new location with `-dx12`.

Current state: Project copied to G drive, launched from there, waiting to see if it opens successfully.
</analysis>

<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - User wanted to open the `UnrealEngine_Bridge.uproject` file in UE 5.7 Editor
   - User wanted the Remote Control API plugin enabled (it was already configured)
   - User wanted the project to compile and run successfully in UE 5.7
   - User wanted the project copied to `G:\UNREAL_PROJECTS_2025\UnrealEngine_Bridge\` and opened from there
   - Throughout the session, the user needed help resolving multiple C++ compilation errors preventing the editor from launching

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Unreal Engine 5.7 with C++ project compilation via UnrealBuildTool
   - UE 5.7 API changes: `IWYUSupportMode` enum removed (default is `IWYUSupport.Full`), `EditorSubsystem.h` include path changed, `IsProcRunning` takes non-const reference
   - UHT (Unreal Header Tool) restrictions: `UFUNCTION` cannot appear in `USTRUCT`, only in `UCLASS`/`UINTERFACE`
   - DLL export macros must match module names (UBT generates `MODULENAME_API`)
   - CDO (Class Default Object) construction happens during module load, before `StartupModule()`
   - Remote Control API on port 30010 for external tool communication
   - Vulkan vs DirectX 12 rendering backend (`-dx12` flag)
   - Project forked from TranslatorsGame/ue-bridge with renamed modules but old API macros

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - `UnrealEngine_Bridge.uproject`
     - Read to identify UE 5.7 engine association, enabled plugins (RemoteControl, PythonScriptPlugin, UEBridge, ViewportPerception, etc.)
     - No changes made

   - `Config/DefaultRemoteControl.ini`
     - Confirmed Remote Control settings: `bRestrictServerAccess=False`, `bEnableRemotePythonExecution=True`, `bAllowConsoleCommandRemoteExecution=True`
     - No changes made

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeEditor/UEBridgeEditor.Build.cs`
     - Removed `IWYUSupport = IWYUSupportMode.Full;` (line 14) — enum doesn't exist in UE 5.7
     - Final state has just `PCHUsage = PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;`

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeRuntime/UEBridgeRuntime.Build.cs`
     - Removed `IWYUSupport = IWYUSupportMode.Full;` (line 13) — same fix
     - Final state has just `PCHUsage = PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;`

   - `Source/UnrealEngineBridge/UnrealEngineBridge.Build.cs`
     - Removed the block: `// Enable IWYU (Include What You Use)\n        IWYUSupport = IWYUSupport.Full;\n`

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeRuntime/Public/BridgeTypes.h`
     - Removed `UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, BlueprintPure, ...)` from `IsValid()` in `FUEBridgeProfile` struct (line 217) — UFUNCTION not allowed in USTRUCT
     - Replaced all `TRANSLATORSBRIDGERUNTIME_API` with `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API` (5 occurrences across struct declarations)
     - Final IsValid: `bool IsValid() const { return Traits.Num() > 0 && !Checksum.IsEmpty(); }`

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeRuntime/Public/UEBridgeSubsystem.h`
     - Replaced `TRANSLATORSBRIDGERUNTIME_API` with `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API` (1 occurrence on class declaration)

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeRuntime/Public/UEBridgeStyle.h`
     - Replaced `TRANSLATORSBRIDGERUNTIME_API` with `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API` (1 occurrence on class declaration)

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeRuntime/Public/UEBridgeRuntime.h`
     - Added `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API` before `DECLARE_LOG_CATEGORY_EXTERN(LogUEBridge, Log, All);` for cross-module DLL export
     - Final: `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API DECLARE_LOG_CATEGORY_EXTERN(LogUEBridge, Log, All);`

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeEditor/Public/BridgeEditorSubsystem.h`
     - Changed `#include "Subsystems/EditorSubsystem.h"` to `#include "EditorSubsystem.h"` — path changed in UE 5.7
     - Replaced `TRANSLATORSBRIDGEEDITOR_API` with `UEBRIDGEEDITOR_API`

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeEditor/Private/BridgeEditorSubsystem.cpp`
     - Fixed const-correctness issue with `IsProcRunning`: moved `const_cast` before the call
     - Changed from:
       ```cpp
       if (BridgeProcessHandle.IsValid() && !FPlatformProcess::IsProcRunning(BridgeProcessHandle))
       {
           UBridgeEditorSubsystem* MutableThis = const_cast<UBridgeEditorSubsystem*>(this);
       ```
     - To:
       ```cpp
       UBridgeEditorSubsystem* MutableThis = const_cast<UBridgeEditorSubsystem*>(this);
       if (BridgeProcessHandle.IsValid() && !FPlatformProcess::IsProcRunning(MutableThis->BridgeProcessHandle))
       {
       ```

   - `Plugins/UEBridge/Source/UEBridgeRuntime/Private/UEBridgeStyle.cpp`
     - Fixed CDO construction crash by lazy-initializing style in `Get()`:
     - Changed from:
       ```cpp
       const ISlateStyle& FUEBridgeStyle::Get()
       {
           check(StyleInstance.IsValid());
           return *StyleInstance;
       }
       ```
     - To:
       ```cpp
       const ISlateStyle& FUEBridgeStyle::Get()
       {
           if (!StyleInstance.IsValid())
           {
               // Lazy init: CDO construction can reach here before StartupModule()
               Initialize();
           }
           return *StyleInstance;
       }
       ```

   - Source/UnrealEngineBridge/ (9 files via subagent) — All `TRANSLATORSCARD_API` replaced with `UNREALENGINEBRIDGE_API`:
     - `BridgeComponent.h`, `UI/UEBridgeGameMode.h`, `UI/UEBridgeHUD.h`, `UI/W_ConnectingScreen.h`, `UI/W_FinaleScreen.h`, `UI/W_OptionButton.h`, `UI/W_ProgressIndicator.h`, `UI/W_QuestionDisplay.h`, `UI/W_TitleScreen.h`

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **`IWYUSupportMode` does not exist (CS0103)**: UE 5.7 removed this enum. Fixed by removing the `IWYUSupport = IWYUSupportMode.Full;` lines from all 3 Build.cs files. The default is already Full.
   - **Stale BuildRules DLL**: Deleted `Intermediate/Build/BuildRules/` to clear cached assembly.
   - **`UFUNCTION` in USTRUCT (UHT error at BridgeTypes.h:217)**: UHT only allows UFUNCTION in UCLASS/UINTERFACE scopes. Fixed by removing the UFUNCTION macro, keeping it as a plain C++ method.
   - **Wrong API export macros (TRANSLATORSBRIDGERUNTIME_API, TRANSLATORSCARD_API, TRANSLATORSBRIDGEEDITOR_API)**: Old fork names didn't match module names. UBT generates export macros from module names. Fixed by renaming to `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API`, `UNREALENGINEBRIDGE_API`, `UEBRIDGEEDITOR_API` across all header files.
   - **`EditorSubsystem.h` not found (C1083)**: Include path `Subsystems/EditorSubsystem.h` changed in UE 5.7. Fixed to `EditorSubsystem.h`.
   - **`LogUEBridge` unresolved external (LNK2001)**: Log category declared in UEBridgeRuntime module but used by UnrealEngineBridge module (separate DLL). Fixed by adding `UEBRIDGERUNTIME_API` to the `DECLARE_LOG_CATEGORY_EXTERN`.
   - **`IsProcRunning` const mismatch (C2664)**: UE 5.7's `FPlatformProcess::IsProcRunning` takes non-const `FProcHandle&`. Called from a const method. Fixed by moving the `const_cast` before the `IsProcRunning` call.
   - **`StyleInstance.IsValid()` assertion crash**: `FUEBridgeStyle::Get()` asserted style was initialized, but CDO construction happens before `StartupModule()`. Fixed by lazy-initializing in `Get()`.
   - **Vulkan crash (`EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION` in nvoglv64)**: NVIDIA Vulkan driver crash. Worked around by launching with `-dx12` flag.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Systematically resolved 8 compilation/runtime errors to get UE 5.7 project compiling and launching
   - Each build attempt revealed new errors that were fixed iteratively
   - The Remote Control API was confirmed working on port 30010 after successful launch
   - Vulkan driver crash worked around with DX12 flag
   - Project successfully copied to `G:\UNREAL_PROJECTS_2025\UnrealEngine_Bridge\` excluding build artifacts

6. All User Messages:
   - "C:\Users\User\UnrealEngine_Bridge\UnrealEngine_Bridge.uproject help me open this"
   - "enable the Remote Control API plugin"
   - "check if the editor is ready"
   - "check again"
   - "it wont open"
   - "open it from the epic games launcher"
   - "says it couldnt be compiled try from source manually"
   - "check if the editor is ready"
   - [Reported StyleInstance assertion crash with full callstack]
   - "check if the editor is ready"
   - [Reported Vulkan EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION crash with full callstack]
   - "I want unrealengine_bridge to save its project in G:\UNREAL_PROJECTS_2025 can you make a copy so the project opens here?"

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Verify the editor launches successfully from `G:\UNREAL_PROJECTS_2025\UnrealEngine_Bridge\` with `-dx12`
   - Confirm Remote Control API is responsive on port 30010 from the new location
   - None of the code changes have been committed to git yet

8. Current Work:
   The project was copied via robocopy to `G:\UNREAL_PROJECTS_2025\UnrealEngine_Bridge\` (excluding Intermediate, Binaries, Saved, .git, DerivedDataCache, .pdb files). The editor was launched from the new location with `-dx12` flag. Waiting for user confirmation that it opens successfully. The copy will need to recompile C++ modules on first open since build artifacts were excluded.

9. Optional Next Step:
   Check if the editor launched successfully from the new G: drive location by running `curl -s http://localhost:30010/remote/info` once the user indicates readiness or asks to check. The user's last request was: "I want unrealengine_bridge to save its project in G:\UNREAL_PROJECTS_2025 can you make a copy so the project opens here?" — the copy was made and editor launched, awaiting confirmation it works.
</summary>
